proof_scope: Named assertions only; Actual SQLite, C08, UI authority, RunStore.read and ContributionReader, with explicit persisted run/envelope test data and a controlled C10 verifier. DecisionBrief is consumed after SQLite reload; MeetingMaterialProposal uses actual ReviewPort, renderer and ArtifactStorage. Case/digest/reference/coverage/order and revocation negatives are covered. No SessionV2 execution or observed skill-load/native receipt. Actual SQLite, C08, Dashboard source lifecycle/issuer/projector, C17 business context, C06 thread port/authority and WP07 exact-source mapping. Canonical create/reply/resolve, unchanged message reread after SQLite reload, persisted-role revocation, physical deletion and same-ID replacement denial are exercised. Authentication, placement, clock and business inputs are fixtures. No message edit/version-history reader, positive deleted-source historical continuity, native execution or private-MCP parity.
